signals.thesis: AMD exploding +11.4% to 52-week high ($456.29) on massive 58M volume. AI inference chip demand accelerating with MI300X/MI350 ramp. FwdPE 35x for 50%+ data center revenue growth. Price 79% above 50-DMA ($254) confirms powerful breakout. Weak DXY ($98.11) amplifies international revenue.

Broadcom within 2% of 52-week high ($437.68) at $430. VMware integration driving recurring revenue transformation. AI networking (Jericho3-AI, custom ASICs) capturing hyperscaler spend. Price 20% above 50-DMA ($358). $2T market cap validates platform thesis.

Qualcomm surging +8.2% near 52-week high ($228) on AI-on-device momentum. Snapdragon X Elite winning PC design wins, automotive pipeline accelerating. Price 55% above 50-DMA ($141). 1.68% dividend yield. FwdPE 20.6x reasonable for diversified growth beyond mobile.

Palo Alto platformization strategy winning enterprise consolidation deals. Price 23% above 50-DMA ($168) with +5.8% Friday surge. Cybersecurity spend remains non-discretionary amid elevated threat landscape. Near 52wk high $223. Free cash flow acceleration supports premium valuation.

CrowdStrike surging +4.4% to $527 — recovering toward pre-incident highs ($566). Charlotte AI platform driving upsell across Falcon modules. 24% above 50-DMA ($425). Endpoint + cloud + identity security bundle creates competitive moat. StockTwits sentiment neutral — room for positive surprise.

Tesla rallying +4% to $428 on autonomous driving and robotaxi catalysts. Optimus robot and FSD v13 creating new TAM narratives. Price 12% above 50-DMA ($383). Shanghai Megapack factory expanding energy storage business. 65M volume confirms institutional participation.

ING Group near 52-week high ($31.18) on strong EU banking tailwind. NII margin expansion from ECB rate normalization. 4.2% dividend yield provides income floor. Price 10% above 50-DMA ($27.40). FwdPE 9.5x deep value for pan-European banking franchise.

UnitedHealth rebounding sharply from $235 lows to near 52wk high ($387). Optum Health + Change Healthcare integration driving earnings power. FwdPE 18.3x reasonable for healthcare megacap. 23% above 50-DMA ($309). 2.33% dividend yield.

iShares Italy ETF at 52-week highs ($59.67). Italian economy outperforming EU peers with strong banking sector (UniCredit, Intesa). Manufacturing PMI recovery. Price 7% above 50-DMA ($55.28). EU fiscal stimulus supporting southern European growth.

iShares China Large-Cap benefiting from policy stimulus and US-China trade detente signals. Tech giants (Alibaba, Tencent, JD) rallying on AI narratives. RSI 56.5 with room to run. Above 50-DMA ($36.34). FwdPE 10.2x extreme discount to DM peers.

stressScenarios.description: Fed rate hike +100bps: equities fall via ERP compression, bonds reprice
Equity market crash -20%: beta-adjusted drawdown across all positions
VIX spike to 40: volatility repricing, equity decline proportional to vol exposure
Crypto crash: BTC -30%, altcoins down more, minimal equity impact
Geopolitical crisis: risk-off flight to safety, equity decline, gold/USD rally
